_doc: item Profile 8 80x40 (0.0.026.04): 80 x 40 mm, Line 8, natural anodised. Dimensions and section figures are item's product data sheet; the groove is item's table of groove dimensions. It is described lying flat, so inertia_x is the smaller second moment (item's x-axis). The drawn outline leaves out the curve of the grooves' flanks (drawn straight) and the rounded mouths.
